title: GHS-BUILT-H R2023A: the average height of the buildings on each 3 arc-second cell of the Earth, 2018
provider: European Commission, Joint Research Centre, Global Human Settlement Layer
credit: GHS-BUILT-H R2023A, European Commission JRC, CC BY 4.0
citation: Pesaresi, M., Politis, P. (2023), GHS-BUILT-H R2023A: GHS building height, derived from AW3D30, SRTM30, and Sentinel-2 composite (2018), European Commission, Joint Research Centre.
format: GeoTIFF in zip archives of 10 degree tiles, fetched behind the scenes the first time a region is seen (data/acquisition/world_city.py) and kept in data/cache/ghsl-built-h/ (3.5 to 95 MB each).
coverage: The whole Earth's land, about 100 m at the equator: an estimate from elevation models and imagery, not a measurement of any building.
